name: 👑 Imad al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; founder; Fars branch; brothers Rukn al-Dawla (Ray) and Mu'izz al-Dawla (Iraq, took Baghdad 945) ruled parallel branches

name: 👑 Rukn al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; senior amir from Imad al-Dawla's death; had ruled Ray/Jibal since 935

name: 👑 'Adud al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; peak of the dynasty; ruled Fars from 949, took Baghdad as amir al-umara 978

name: 👑 Samsam al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; senior line reckoned by Baghdad; later ruled Fars 989-998

name: 👑 Sharaf al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; held Fars from 983 before taking Baghdad

name: 👑 Baha al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; reunited Iraq and Fars

name: 👑 Sultan al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; kept Fars until 1024; Iraq line continues the senior mainline

name: 👑 Jalal al-Dawla
party: year-level backbone; Iraq branch; rivalry with Abu Kalijar of Fars

name: 👑 Abu Kalijar
party: year-level backbone; ruled Fars from 1024; senior amir uniting Iraq and Fars from 1044

name: 👑 Al-Malik al-Rahim
party: year-level backbone; Iraq branch; deposed when Seljuk Tughril took Baghdad 1055

name: 👑 Abu Mansur Fulad Sutun
party: year-level backbone; Fars branch, parallel to al-Malik al-Rahim; last Buyid ruler
